# Load libraries
```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
```
#to make the .csv that feeds into cell profiler 
```{r}
path <- "/Users/compt/SynologyDrive/iPSC-hepatocyte experiment/Staining/IPSC (ch0=dapi, ch1= oct4, ch2=sox2)/raw images/"
files <- list.files(
  path         = path,
  pattern      = "\\.tif$",
  recursive    = TRUE,   # <-- goes into slide1_female/, slide2_male/
  full.names   = TRUE    # <-- keeps the full path so we can extract folder name
)

pattern <- "^(.*?)(?:[_ ]n(\\d+))?[_ ]c(\\d+)-(\\d+)_ch(\\d+)$"

df <- tibble(filepath = files) %>%
  mutate(
    fname = basename(filepath) %>% str_remove("\\.tif$"),
    parts = str_match(fname, pattern),
    condition = str_trim(parts[, 2]),
    n         = as.integer(parts[, 3]),   # NA if the file has no _n#
    coverslip = as.integer(parts[, 4]),
    image     = as.integer(parts[, 5]),
    channel   = as.integer(parts[, 6]),
    slide = str_extract(filepath, "(?i)slide\\s?\\d+") %>%
      str_extract("\\d+") %>%
      as.integer(),
    sex = str_extract(filepath, "(?i)(female|male)") %>% str_to_lower()
  ) %>%
  select(-parts)


# Add channel info
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    stain = case_when(
      channel == 0 ~ "DNA",
      channel == 1 ~ "Oct4", #green
      channel == 2 ~ "Sox2", #RED
    )
  )

# Reshape for CP — one image per row
df_cp <- df %>%
  mutate(
    FileName = basename(filepath),
    PathName = dirname(normalizePath(filepath))                 
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(coverslip, image, condition, slide, sex),
    names_from = stain,
    values_from = c(FileName, PathName),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{stain}"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("Metadata_", .), c(coverslip, image, condition, slide, sex))

# Clean up
df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  rename_with(~gsub(" ", "", .))

df_cp <- df_cp %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ sapply(., `[`, 1)))

sapply(df_cp, class)

#each slide should be run seprately in fluerecence chnages
df_cp %>%
  group_split(Metadata_slide, Metadata_sex) %>%
  walk(~{
    slide_id <- unique(.x$Metadata_slide)
    sex_id <- unique(.x$Metadata_sex)
    
    write_csv(.x, paste0("/Users/compt/SynologyDrive/iPSC-hepatocyte experiment/Staining/IPSC (ch0=dapi, ch1= oct4, ch2=sox2)/Metadata/metadata_slide_", slide_id, sex_id, ".csv"))
  })

```

# Load Nuclei.csv from every slide folder
```{r}
load_nuclei <- function(path, slide = NULL) {
  if (is.null(slide)) {
    slide <- list.dirs(path, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
    slide <- slide[str_detect(slide, "^Slide")]
  }
  map_dfr(slide, function(s) {
    f <- file.path(path, s, "Nuclei.csv")
    message("Reading: ", f)
    read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(slide_folder = s)
  })
}

nuclei <- load_nuclei(cell_profiler_input_path)

# Check what CellProfiler exported
grep("^Classify_|^Math_", names(nuclei), value = TRUE)
```

# Turn the Classify_ columns into one class column
```{r}
class_labels <- c(
  Classify_Sox2pos_Oct4pos = "Sox2+/Oct4+",
  Classify_Sox2pos_Oct4neg = "Sox2+/Oct4-",
  Classify_Sox2neg_Oct4pos = "Sox2-/Oct4+",
  Classify_NonIPSC         = "Non-Stem cell"
)
class_levels <- unname(class_labels)

missing_cols <- setdiff(names(class_labels), names(nuclei))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Not found in Nuclei.csv: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
       "\nCheck the names with grep('^Classify_', names(nuclei), value = TRUE)")
}

class_mat <- as.matrix(nuclei[names(class_labels)])
class_mat[is.na(class_mat)] <- 0
assigned <- rowSums(class_mat) > 0

nuclei <- nuclei %>%
  mutate(class = if_else(
    assigned,
    class_levels[max.col(class_mat, ties.method = "first")],
    "Unclassified"
  ))

nuclei <- nuclei %>%
  mutate(
    class = if_else(class == "Unclassified", "Non-Stem cell", class),
    class = factor(class, levels = class_levels)
  )

```

# Summaries: image -> slide -> sex
```{r}
# Step 1: percent of each class per image (classes absent from an image = 0%)
class_image <- nuclei %>%
  count(Metadata_sex, Metadata_slide, Metadata_coverslip, ImageNumber, class, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(Metadata_sex, Metadata_slide, Metadata_coverslip, ImageNumber) %>%
  filter(sum(n) > 0) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: mean across images within each coverslip
class_coverslip <- class_image %>%
  group_by(Metadata_sex, Metadata_slide, Metadata_coverslip, class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(percent),
    n_images     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 2: mean across images within each slide
class_slide <- class_coverslip %>%
  group_by(Metadata_sex, Metadata_slide, class) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_percent = mean(mean_percent),
    n_coverslips     = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: mean, SD and SE across slides within each sex
class_summary <- class_slide %>%
  group_by(Metadata_sex, class) %>%
  summarise(
    grand_mean = mean(mean_percent),
    sd         = sd(mean_percent),
    n_slides   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n_slides))

class_summary
```

# Shared plot style
```{r}
# Stacked plot: classes grouped into developmental stages
class_groups <- tribble(
  ~class,          ~stage,
  "Sox2+/Oct4+",   "Pluripotent",
  "Sox2+/Oct4-",   "Exiting pluripotency",
  "Sox2-/Oct4+",   "Exiting pluripotency",
  "Non-Stem cell", "Pluripotency-negative"
)

stage_levels <- c("Pluripotent", "Exiting pluripotency", "Pluripotency-negative")

# Shades grouped by stage, so the pieces within each bar look related
class_colors <- c(
  "Non-Stem cell"   = "grey70",
  "Sox2-/Oct4+" = "#0d0887",
  "Sox2+/Oct4-" = "#5c01a6",
  "Sox2+/Oct4+" = "#ed7953"
)

p_class <- ggplot(class_summary,
                  aes(x = class, y = grand_mean, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(grand_mean - se, 0), ymax = grand_mean + se),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = class_slide,
    aes(x = class, y = mean_percent, color = class),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1),
    size = 3, alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = class_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.025, 0.05))) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_class
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "class.png"), p_class,
       width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

class_stage <- class_summary %>%
  mutate(class = as.character(class)) %>%
  left_join(class_groups, by = "class") %>%
  mutate(stage = factor(stage, levels = stage_levels),
         class = factor(class, levels = names(class_colors)))


p_stacked <- ggplot(class_stage,
                    aes(x = stage, y = grand_mean, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, position = position_stack(),
           colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Image_Metadata_sex) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Phenotype", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

p_stacked


# class breakdown for each slide (spot outlier slides)
p_per_slide <- ggplot(class_slide,
                      aes(x = Image_Metadata_slide, y = mean_percent, fill = class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, position = position_stack()) +
  facet_grid(~ Image_Metadata_sex, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_colors, name = "Phenotype") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(y = "% of nuclei", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() 

p_per_slide
```
